arm_gap_u2_vs_u2_numerics.reading: this is the size of UPSTREAM's own defect (D024 rule 2: a quaternion-renormalization defect, a reflection defect in principal-axis alignment, and a combo-gradient weighting defect; T02 measured 1.2% of upstream's poses reporting a Tanimoto no rigid motion can achieve). It is NOT a ROSHAMBO3 margin and must never be quoted as one.
